drums.tags: Dark ambient soundscape with industrial and cinematic elements. A low-frequency drone oscillates at approximately 60 BPM. Metallic textures and mechanical grinding sounds occur at irregular intervals. A high-pitched, resonant filter sweep moves across the stereo field. Distant, reverberant clangs and industrial machinery hums create a dense atmospheric layer. The piece lacks a traditional melodic key or rhythmic pulse, focusing instead on textural evolution and spatial depth through heavy reverb and delay processing. Sub-bass frequencies remain constant while mid-range metallic scrapes provide sporadic rhythmic accents.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[low-frequency drone, mechanical hum]

[Section A]
[metallic grinding sounds, resonant filter sweep]
[distant reverberant clangs]

[Section B]
[sub-bass oscillation, industrial textures]
[high-pitched metallic scrapes]

bass.tags: Indie rock with a lo-fi aesthetic. A clean electric guitar plays a repetitive, syncopated four-chord progression using palm-muted eighth notes. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar with a rounded, warm tone. Drums consist of a tight, dry snare and a steady kick drum pattern with occasional eighth-note fills on the rack tom. A second electric guitar enters with a bright, jangly tone playing melodic lead lines in the upper register. The tempo is 112 BPM in the key of G Major and 4/4 time signature.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[clean electric guitar palm-muted riff]
[bass guitar enters]

[Main Theme]
[dry snare and kick drum enter]
[jangly lead electric guitar melody]

[Bridge]
[lead guitar drops out]
[palm-muted guitar continues with bass and drums]

[Outro]
[lead guitar re-enters]
[final snare hit and guitar ring out]
